title: Name this visual system
question: Scan found a coherent incumbent: Functional Clarity — opaque plates, 1px outline-variant seams, Manrope, one violet interactive accent (#7C3AED), no glass/blur/gradient chrome. Entity identity (beacons, capsules) may use generated gradients; chrome may not. Light default, purple-tinted dark. This round only names the atmosphere — tokens are already extracted. Which Creative North Star should DESIGN.md lead with?

options.label: Functional Clarity
options.thesis: Keep the shipped name. The system is a neo-brutal desk: solid fills, quiet seams, one violet switch.
options.body: Overview voice: de-AI-ified, modular bordered panels, depth by tone not blur. Primary color character: Click Violet. Anti-references: glass, neon glow, gradient text, a second interactive accent, Space Grotesk.

options.label: The Opaque Room
options.thesis: Same system, named as a physical room: walls you cannot see through, seams you can count, one light switch.
options.body: Overview voice: presence over atmosphere; every chrome surface is a plate. Primary color character: Electric Violet. Same bans as Functional Clarity; the name just makes the no-glass rule unforgettable.
options.case: Honors PRODUCT.md presence-over-feed without inventing a new look.

options.label: The Handshake Ledger
options.thesis: Same system, named as a ledger of verified encounters: cards as entries, violet as the only stamp.
options.body: Overview voice: facts on plates, not moods in glass. Primary color character: Handshake Violet. Same tokens and bans; the metaphor ties chrome to verified cliques.
options.case: Honors PRODUCT.md handshake positioning; still documents the incumbent, not a redesign.
